content.instructions: After a quantity word there is no article, and the measure word stays singular (“zwei Kilo”). A countable noun after it is plural: “ein Kilo Äpfel, 500 Gramm Käse, ein Liter Milch, eine Packung Nudeln”. Ask “Was kostet das Kilo?” For "how many" with countable things use “Wie viele?”: “Wie viele Eier?”
